title: Momentum
description: Just a lighter, smoother way to play. Designed for enhanced performance, reliable updates, with a vanilla look and feel.
body:
# **The Only Performance Modpack You'll Ever Need**

Experience Minecraft at its fastest! This modpack was built for players who refuse to compromise between massive features and buttery-smooth performance. I’ve handpicked a powerful selection of mods and integrated advanced optimization tools so you can explore, build, and conquer without the dreaded lag spike. Feel the **_momentum_** as you traverse new worlds; it's powerful modding running perfectly on your machine, while keeping the vanilla look and feel.

## Apart from performance mods, there are **few** **Quality of Life** mods present in this modpack:

1. 3D Skin Layers
2. AppleSkin
3. Better Statistics Screen
4. Continuity
5. Dark Loading Screen
6. Flashback
7. Gamma Utils
8. JourneyMap (**Disable by pressing F5**)
9. LambDynamicLights
10. Resourcify
11. Simple HUD Enhanced
12. Zooomify
13. Shulker Box Tooltip
14. SmoothHUD

### **The only controversial mod is JourneyMap. Some players prefer them, some do not. I've added it anyway, and it can be toggled off by pressing F5. It disables the minimap.**

All of these mods are **QOL only**, and completely **client side**. They are **non-intrusive**. They can be easily disabled if you do not prefer them. 

I hope this modpack brings upon performance and that you are able to experience Minecraft lag-free and smoothly without any interruptions. Hope you have a great day :)
